"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A defined-contribution model is the only way to limit costs and restore consumer choice for patients and introduce competition.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Genuine competition is the best guarantee of better care at lower cost in healthcare, as in any other sector of the economy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Competition is the best guard against fraud and abuse that have plagued Medicare in its isolation from free market forces.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Fraud and abuse in Medicare costs taxpayers billions of dollars every year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a transition to a premium-support model for Medicare, with an income-adjusted contribution toward a health plan of the enrollee's choice.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The premium-support model will include private health insurance plans that provide catastrophic protection, to ensure the continuation of doctor-patient relationships.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The age eligibility for Medicare must be made more realistic in terms of today's longer life span, without disadvantaging retirees or those nearing retirement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"No changes will be made for those 55 and older.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
